nodes.name: fuzzer.go
nodes.summary: Declares the fuzzer function set for the meta API group, currently returning an empty list so that round-trip fuzz tests use only default Kubernetes fuzzing behaviour.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines an exported package-level variable holding a closure over a runtime codec factory, the standard k8s fuzzer registration idiom.

nodes.name: OWNERS
nodes.summary: Reviewer ownership rules for the CertificateRequest controller package, requiring joshvanl to review changes to the generated apply configuration files.

nodes.name: OWNERS
nodes.summary: Reviewer ownership rules for the certificates controller package, requiring joshvanl to review changes to the generated apply configuration files.

nodes.summary: Reviewer ownership rules for the ACME challenges controller package, requiring joshvanl to review changes to the generated apply configuration files.

nodes.summary: Reviewer ownership rules for the issuers controller package, requiring joshvanl to review changes to the generated apply configuration files.

nodes.summary: Reviewer ownership rules for the ACME orders controller package, requiring joshvanl to review changes to the generated apply configuration files.

nodes.name: doc.go
nodes.summary: Package declaration file for the models-schema code generation command that emits the OpenAPI model schema consumed by the generated client and API reference.
nodes.languageNotes: A Go package clause only (package main); all generator logic lives in sibling files, this file just carries the license header and package name.

nodes.name: issue-ghsa-r4pg-vg54-wxx4.bin
nodes.summary: Malformed PEM corpus file used as a regression fixture for the GHSA-r4pg-vg54-wxx4 vulnerability, feeding hostile multi-block BEGIN sequences into the PEM decoder test.
nodes.languageNotes: Binary fuzz-style corpus entry; the decoder must reject or safely normalize the concatenated malformed headers without panicking.

nodes.name: client.go
nodes.summary: In-memory fake implementation of the HashiCorp Vault API client used by issuer unit tests, allowing canned raw responses and captured tokens without a live Vault server.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a fluent builder pattern (WithX methods returning the receiver) and injects *testing.T for assertions inside request handlers.

nodes.name: FakeClient
nodes.summary: Struct implementing the Vault client surface, storing the canned request, a pluggable raw-request handler, the captured token, and the test handle.

nodes.name: NewFakeClient
nodes.summary: Constructs a FakeClient with an empty request and a raw-request handler that fails the test by returning an unexpected-call error.

nodes.name: WithRawRequest
nodes.summary: Configures the fake to return a fixed response and error pair for any raw request, returning the client for chaining.

nodes.name: WithRawRequestFn
nodes.summary: Installs a custom raw-request handler that receives the client's *testing.T, enabling per-test assertions on outgoing Vault requests.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Explains the cert-manager logo assets, notes that other organisation repositories reference these files by location, and points to the licence terms.

nodes.name: 00_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Root build configuration that sets repository-wide variables such as Go source lists, build flags, binary names, chart paths, and toolchain options before any other make module is included.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GNU Make's call/eval helpers and ordering conventions where numbered module files load in sequence (00 sets variables, 02 defines targets).

nodes.name: 02_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Aggregates the project's Make modules (CI, tests, containers, release, manifests, licences, scanning) and defines top-level targets for tidying, licence generation, and base-image updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Central include hub; most behaviour comes from the included make/*.mk files, with this file only adding a handful of phony aggregate targets.

nodes.name: 00_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Defines the default Go license header template path and the overridable go_header_file variable used by the shared boilerplate module.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Adds shared make targets that verify every file carries the correct license boilerplate via boilersuite and copy the base LICENSE into the repository.

nodes.name: boilerplate.go.txt
nodes.summary: Apache 2.0 license header template stamped onto generated and hand-written Go files by the shared boilerplate tooling.

nodes.name: 00_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Initialises the shared lists of generate and verify targets that individual make modules append to, letting the shared layer discover them generically.

nodes.name: 02_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Defines the generic generate and verify targets, expanding every registered generate target into a verify-% rule that reruns it in an isolated copy of the repo.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pattern rules plus GNU Make foreach/expansion to derive verify targets, and marks side-effecting targets to run last.

nodes.name: verify.sh
nodes.summary: Helper that copies the repository to a temporary directory, reruns a supplied make target there, and diffs the result against the working tree to prove generated files are committed.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately avoids rsync (macOS ships openrsync with differing semantics) and copies top-level entries with find plus cp -af, trapping EXIT/SIGINT to clean up.

nodes.name: .golangci.override.yaml
nodes.summary: Shared golangci-lint v2 overlay that enables a broad linter set, staticcheck tuning, exclusion presets, and gci/gofmt formatters merged into each repo's own lint config.
nodes.languageNotes: v2 schema with default:none and an explicit enable list; the {{REPO-NAME}} placeholder is substituted at generation time for gci import grouping.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Shared Go tooling module providing targets for go.work creation, go mod tidy across modules, govulncheck scanning, and generating/verifying/fixing the golangci-lint configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Iterates over every go.mod outside _bin and make/_shared using find plus a pushd/popd loop, and intentionally keeps verify-govulncheck out of make verify so new CVEs do not block PRs.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: One-line description of the shared make module that bundles Go static analysis checks.

nodes.name: govulncheck.yaml
nodes.summary: Generated GitHub Actions workflow that runs make verify-govulncheck nightly and on demand to surface newly disclosed Go vulnerabilities affecting the repository.
nodes.languageNotes: Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and the job is guarded by a repository-name check so the generated file can be copied safely across org repos.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Registers the make help target, forwarding the active MAKEFILE_LIST and make binary to the shared help.sh renderer.

nodes.name: help.sh
nodes.summary: Renders a categorised make help screen by parsing ## doc comments, @category markers, and target rules out of every included makefile and expanding variable-based target names.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bash regex matching plus sentinel-string templating to build line items, then sorts them in reverse for stable category grouping.

nodes.name: 01_mod.mk
nodes.summary: Provides klone targets for syncing and upgrading the shared makefile modules, with generate-klone deliberately excluded from automatic generation so versions are pinned manually.
